reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00410370 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/humanplayer/00410370-HumanPlayer_LoadParameters_11.cpp at sha256 a2cf6705d6aecc87df95b6b8c84b70e39fdf7aa1cc97f29730481937c8060401 (recorded implementation.signature: unresolved). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.
